summary: This filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Ambev S.A., a Brazilian beverage company, incorporating its updated bylaws. It is a routine corporate governance document that does not announce any transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation. The registrant is the issuer filing the report. There are no deal terms or structural changes beyond standard bylaw updates. The filing lacks any catalyst for event-driven analysis; it is purely administrative. No further action or risk-arb angle is applicable.
